source_image: image/บ้าน_เล็ก_1ชั้น_54/บ้าน_เล็ก_1ชั้น_54_หน้า10.png
warnings: Type schedule with a printed จำนวน (count) per type — count is the printed number. Marks kept as printed (ป = door, น = window).

Doors ป2 and ป3 print two widths (0.90/0.80, 0.80/0.70): the outer one is the frame (width_m), the inner one the leaf (leaf_width_m). Every head is printed against ระดับพื้นห้อง: doors and windows น1-น3 at 2.05, น4 at 2.15.
Window sill heights are printed on the elevations (น1/น3 0.85, น2 0.30, น4 1.65); height_m is the opening height (น1/น3 1.20, น2 1.75, น4 0.50).
